get.description: Paginated list of customers from the analytics store.
Fetch a single customer by ID.

Paginated list of events for a customer (name, type, timestamp only).

Matches events across multiple identifiers: the numeric ids (``customer_id``
and ``user_id``), the customer's email, and their phone number. This catches
events regardless of which field the analytics pipeline used to associate
them (see :func:`app.services.customers.fetch_events_page`).

get.description:
Whether the Zid store behind this source has completed OAuth.

Lets the dashboard's Zid setup wizard check that tokens exist before it
calls connect-zid, so a merchant who hasn't authorised yet gets a clear
"authorise first" prompt instead of a 502 from the webhook step.
``connected`` is true only when the zid-app has valid tokens for the store.

get.description:
Look up the Jitsu ingest config for a Zid store, cross-account.

Returns the per-store ingest URL and write key, or 404 if no source is
configured for this store_id. Used by zid-app to route events to the
correct Jitsu source.

404.description: No source found for this store_id

post.description:
Report that a Zid app installation completed and record the store UUID.

The dashboard user creates a source using the Zid dashboard store_id.
When the merchant installs the app, zid-app learns the storefront UUID
(window.store_uuid). This endpoint records that UUID against the source so
browser events loaded without an explicit ?store_id= can be resolved to the
correct source.

404.description: No source found for this dashboard store_id
